objective: The frozen exact census of four-point maps on random knot spaces of 16 to 20 points and genus 2 to 4, any instance of the two missing kinds refereed by fresh code, and the proof attempt.
status: Proved 2026-11-11: the four classes of self-dual four-point map, only the switch and a+NAE able to give a mod-3 bit, all four realisable by general not-all-equal systems (not forced); exact census of 453 random knot spaces of 16 to 20 points (genus 2 to 4), refereed on 46: no switch and no a+NAE; four-point readings thin out past 16 points. Proof of absence not found.
title: Four-point maps on larger knot spaces, and a reason
